reviews.t: It takes time but definitely helps
reviews.x: I bought this at a deep discount at a JC Penny's that was closing.  I don't normally buy salon shampoos but hair has been thinning for years and I hoped this would help.  It took 3 months before people started commenting on how great my hair looked!  I noticed a difference after 6-7 weeks - just shinier and easier to manage, but after 3 months there is no denying it has helped with the thinning.  I bought the big containers after deciding I couldn't go back to regular shampoo now.  I am a life-l

reviews.t: Scent is not overpowering like some products.
reviews.x: I love most Paul Mitchell products and this one specifically.  Scent is nice and not super perfume-y like many so called 'botanicals' can be.  Washes/rinses out clean and absolutely makes hair look fuller.  I do wish Amazon had packed this better though.  Box was open at the bottom due to weight of product.  I think they can spring for double taping heavy packages.

Originally i had ordered the smaller bottles to make sure i liked the product…LOVED IT! So I ordered the larger bottles with the pump to last longer and I am disappointed the product does not work as well and seems watered down.

First, the smell of this shampoo and conditioner is so refreshing. Second, my hair was falling out and getting thin, but this shampoo and conditioner has thickened my hair and helped it to stop falling out. I am amazed at the difference in my hair, and other people have noticed too. I know it seems the price is a little steep, but it is worth every penny you spend on it. If your hair is thinning and falling out this is the shampoo and conditioner you need to get!

reviews.t: Smells great and actually makes my hair thicker.
reviews.x: I've used Paul Mitchell's tea tree shampoo for years.  All other shampoos quickly become irritating to my scalp.  The scent of the lemon sage really appealed to me when my hair stylist used it on me so when it came time to replace my regular tea tree shampoo I switched to the lemon sage.  My husband tried it too, and loves it.  We now sport thicker and shinier hair.  I'm a tight wad, and this shampoo seems pricey,  but it's worth every penny.

First off, one of the bottles was missing a good amount of conditioner as if it was used a few times. This was apparent by comparing to the shampoo bottle is came with. Upon use, it seemed nothing like the tea tree products I have bought in store. Usually the product is thick and creamy, this seemed very watered down. It crossed my mind that it could be a knock off or someone is watering down the product for profit.

I ordered the combination 1 shampoo/1 conditioner. I was impressed with the packaging - no leaks. The 3 stars are because I opened the package only to discover they had sent me 2 shampoos and no conditioner. I wonder how many other duo pairings have been incorrectly sent. I will keep the extra shampoo because it will be used, just disappointed because I am still out of conditioner.

This is definitely a knock off.  The search says Paul Mitchell but watch carefully because when you get to the product, it does not.  My bottle does not appear as the one in the image.  It does not have the Paul Mitchell logo.  But I was still deceived into buying it as a Paul Mitchell product.  It is adequate shampoo and conditioner but really doesn't smell all that great.

The tea tree line from Paul Mitchell is the only shampoo/conditioner I have used the last three years. All of them smell wonderful and are not heavy. I recently got my hair cut and the hair stylist made multiple comments about the health of my hair which is amazing as I am a mechanic by trade so my hair sees a lot of dirt and damaging chemicals. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

This is really great. I have a really dry scalp and thin hair and it helped with it a lot. It smells amazing too. The caps are a bit hard to unlock.  *4 stars only cause every time it's shipped it has no packing pads and some leaks out.

reviews.t: THE BEST for thin, fine hair!
reviews.x: I'm a cancer survivor. My hair didn't come back thick at all. Since using this shampoo, it has been thicker and softer than any other I've tried. As an added bonus, I love the smell!!
Shampoo is great. Leaves your hair clean with a beautiful scent and it gives hair volume. However, the conditioner it’s not all that! I rather use shampoo alone.
I’ve been using this brand for a while now and I love how it makes my hair and scalp feel so clean and fresh, scent is amazing
I’ve been using this brand for a while now and I love how it makes my hair and scalp feel so clean and fresh, scent is amazing

reviews.t: Lasted me almost a full year, and only thickening product that worked for me
reviews.x: I ordered this December of last year and as of writing this review I ran out, so hopefully that gives you a perspective of its price point. I’ve tried other brands like OGX and their thickening feels temporary. With this, it will feel temporary for a bit but after months of using it, my hair truly felt more thick. I had to use a different shampoo since I ran out of it and my hair instantly went thin and didn’t feel the same, so I definitely recommend getting their product.

This was my go to for years, but for the last few years I've been mixing it up a lot- trying new things, new brands. I'm pretty loyally back to the original. It works well for fine, thin hair and it appears a lot fuller and thicker.. Best, it doesn't break my scalp ou or add to drying out in this high desert. It is a tad "spendy," but a little goes a long way and the liters will probably last me a year. Oh yeah, smells good and feels good.

reviews.t: disappointed how it shipped, but great product!
reviews.x: I'm very happy with how the  product makes my hair feel and make manageable. How ever I gave 4 stars only because the shampoo came oozing out so i lost some product, so I was not pleased with that at all! I expect perfection in a package all other companies I've purchased in the past have done it i can expect it from this company as well.

reviews.t: This is a a great product, too bad it was packaged poorly
reviews.x: The product is amazing.  that is why I ordered it.  But it was packaged so poorly, it was so slimy I could hardly even lift it up.  Both bottles were leaking and it was everywhere.  I did not pay this much for shampoo for it to be all over before I got to use it.  I was going to order another one, but was afraid it would end up the same.

I ended up returning this item because originally I had used the shampoo and conditioner at a hotel that’s why I decided to buy this product years later. However, it did not meet my standards because it was not concentrated enough. Being that it’s the original sent it wasn’t even close to the concentrated ones from the hotel.

reviews.t: Very good quality product but needs a refill option
reviews.x: This is a very high-quality shampoo. My biggest complaint is the plastic pump bottles it comes in. I have not found refill bottles so you have to buy and discard the plastic pump every time. This is a waste of resources. Let us save the pump and just buy a refill. The product is also a bit pricey.

reviews.t: WARNING- made my hair fall out
reviews.x: This product literally made my hair fall out after maybe 3 washes. I had colored hair but it hadn’t been colored for months during the time I was using this product, and my stylist at the saloon said she’s had multiple clients that have experienced this while using this shampoo and conditioner.

The shampoo and conditioner Smell fantastic! Your hair will not stay clean for more than one day and I do not wash my hair every day. I have very long fine hair and it is too expensive to be able to wash my hair every day anyway. Price is not conducive to every day washing

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product makes their hair look and feel thicker or fuller, especially those with thinning or fine hair.
Reviewers frequently praise the lemon sage scent as pleasant, refreshing, and not overpowering.
Several reviewers report shipping and packaging problems, including leaks, missing packing material, and open or damaged boxes.
Some reviewers received incorrect or seemingly used/watered-down products, including wrong item combinations and suspected knock-offs.
A few reviewers with fine hair find the product too heavy, leaving hair stringy, flat, or weighed down.
